alfriendschat.tutorial.quick.title: Quick start
alfriendschat.tutorial.quick:
1. Open the Chat Templates tab → click [Generate from message…]
2. Paste/type a real line with a name (e.g. [VIP]Steve: hello) → click [Generate]
3. The template is added automatically; the preview box fills in that line and shows the parse result (name=xxx | content=xxx)
4. Adjust the template or preview if the result is wrong; click [Save] at the bottom when done

Whisper templates: same flow in the Whisper Templates tab, using a whisper line (e.g. Alex whispered to you: in there?)
Right-click Copy saves only the body text — just type a sample line with a name instead
alfriendschat.tutorial.concept.title: What is a template
alfriendschat.tutorial.concept:
Plugins/NCR often reformat chat; the guards can only tell "a player is speaking" but cannot read the name and body out of an unfamiliar format.
A template tells the mod where the name and body sit — one template parses most formats.
Display name = the full name with titles: in [Survival][Newbie]player>>hello the display name is [Survival][Newbie]player and the body is hello — the template {display_name}{sep}{content} parses it
alfriendschat.tutorial.fields.title: How to fill
alfriendschat.tutorial.fields:
Fields: {display_name} display name (with titles) | {content} body | {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver | {sep} auto-matches >>, :, ：, » or spaces
Example: {display_name}{sep}{content} matches Steve: hello, Steve >> hello and Steve hello
Whisper: {sender} whispered to you{sep}{content} matches Alex whispered to you: in there?
{content} can sit anywhere (suffix styles work too); multi-colored names are handled automatically
Fill in the shape you see in chat, then verify with the preview box
alfriendschat.tutorial.faq.title: FAQ
alfriendschat.tutorial.faq:
Template never matches? Separators must match verbatim (what you type is what it matches); a title containing a colon truncates the name
Generate failed? The message must contain an online or seen player name
"Seen" = the mod remembers players you chatted with, so it recognizes them even offline
A nickname that shares no characters with the real name, while offline, may not resolve (shows grey) — known limitation
Empty template list? The guards take over, everything works as before
Permissions/file? /alfriendschat gui needs OP; config lives in config/alfriendschat-server.toml
alfriendschat.tutorial.why.title: How it works (brief)
alfriendschat.tutorial.why:
alfriendschat judges messages with three guards: translation keys/click events first (Guard 0), then name position + separator structure (Guard 1), finally "not sure → don't claim, show grey" (Guard 2).
A template = you declare the format: a hit splits the fields directly and skips the guard chain.
Recognition ≠ parsing: guards guess "is this a player", templates read the exact name and body.
(Does not affect usage — feel free to skip)

alfriendschat.server.use_tpa.desc: When enabled, the head-menu teleport action uses /tpa instead of /tp. /tpa is provided by server plugins (EssentialsX etc.) or mods (FTB Essentials) — vanilla servers have no /tpa.
alfriendschat.server.history.desc: On join, the server sends recent chat history to new players. Only affects servers that run the alfriendschat server-side component.
alfriendschat.server.media_enabled.desc: Host chat images on the server (alfriendschat://media/, permanent); off = images go through the third-party host only.
alfriendschat.server.media_auto_clean.de: Automatically delete server-hosted chat images older than 7 days (checked on server start, then at most every 6h after uploads). Off = images kept forever.
alfriendschat.server.template_debug.desc: Logs every system-chat line that fails every template to the client log (prefix: System(template miss)). Useful while tuning templates.
alfriendschat.server.template_n.desc: Template format: {prefix} decoration prefix, {display_name} player name (may include decorations), {content} message body (must be the last field), {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver. Leave the list empty to disable templates and let the guards take over.
alfriendschat.server.actions.desc: Add creates a blank template row. Below, the preset section offers common formats ready to add in one click.
alfriendschat.server.gen.desc: Paste a real chat line and generate — the template is inferred automatically (the message must contain an online or seen player name).
alfriendschat.server.preview.desc: Type any message to preview parsing instantly — shows the matched name and content.
alfriendschat.image.preview_close: Click anywhere or press Esc to close
alfriendschat.config.receive_images.desc: When off, image codes in chat history render as plain [Image] text and nothing is downloaded
